# Surbhi Hote

> Lead Product Designer (8+ years) working on complex B2B, enterprise, and ad-tech products. Designs and vibe codes production-ready product experiences, using AI across the whole design process.

Site: https://surbhihote.com
Contact: surbhihote@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/surbhihote/
Full text for LLMs: https://surbhihote.com/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://surbhihote.com/sitemap.xml

## About
Surbhi Hote is a Lead Product Designer with a computer science background. She specializes in UX for complex enterprise systems, design systems, and AI-first product design, and uses AI tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Figma Make) to move from idea to shipped product. Based in the US; previously and currently working with B2B/ad-tech and manufacturing-tech teams.

## Case studies
- [Affiliate Website Redesign](https://surbhihote.com/work/affiliate-platform-redesign): Redesign of a legacy affiliate ordering platform; research, workshops, and a phased rollout without disrupting existing users.
- [Tech Pack Tool](https://surbhihote.com/work/solace): Moving document-centric apparel workflows into a connected PLM ecosystem (CAD library, materials, BOM, tech pack editor).
- [Notifications Management](https://surbhihote.com/work/atlas): Granular, role-aware notification preferences across web and mobile.
- [Audience Builder](https://surbhihote.com/work/fjord): A tool for building custom audience segments in an ad-tech platform.

## AI projects
- [AI Projects index](https://surbhihote.com/ai)
- [Creator Hub](https://surbhihote.com/creator-hub-ai-product-design-case-study): MIT xPRO capstone — an LLM-powered content workspace for social media creators; product strategy, RAG, and AI evaluation.
- [Voyager](https://surbhihote.com/ai/voyager): An AI travel companion designed end to end with generative tools — conversational UI, itinerary generation, map experiences.
- [Vibe Coded Portfolio](https://surbhihote.com/vibe-coding-my-portfolio-lovable): How this portfolio was designed and vibe coded on Lovable with Claude Code and Cursor.
- [AI Resources for Product Designers](https://surbhihote.com/ai/resources): Tools, prompt patterns, and downloadable templates — adoption guide, bias audit worksheet, guardrails, governance, prompt library.
